name: jev-compact-gate
description: Jev decides when the session compacts, inside a 280k–400k token band; Claude's own summary does the compacting.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow logs every verdict without compacting; live acts on them.

floorTokens.title: Band floor (tokens)
floorTokens.description: Below this context size the gate never asks Jev.

ceilingTokens.title: Band ceiling (tokens)
ceilingTokens.description: At or above this context size the gate compacts without asking.

boundaryMax.title: Boundary threshold at the floor
boundaryMax.description: P(a unit of work just closed) required to compact at the floor.

boundaryMin.title: Boundary threshold at the ceiling
boundaryMin.description: P(a unit of work just closed) required to compact just below the ceiling.

verbatimVeto.title: Verbatim veto
verbatimVeto.description: P(next step needs exact recent tool output) at or above which the gate holds.

debugPenalty.title: Debugging penalty
debugPenalty.description: Added to the boundary threshold, weighted by P(phase = debugging).

cooldownTurns.title: Cooldown turns
cooldownTurns.description: Main-loop turns after a compaction before the gate may act again.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: A Jev call slower than this holds.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: OpenRouter model id, pinned to a release rather than jev-latest.
